text:
Maya (support-lead): Morning async — quick triage snapshot. Current queue: ~18 open tickets (4 P1/P2). Notable: intermittent failures on embeddings webhook (seen in #4821 and #4830), customers reporting delayed webhook retries. I pushed a short macro update to mention workaround; can someone volunteer to watch escalations for the next 2 hours?
Nate (oncall): I can take the first 2h. I looked at logs, appears related to a retry storm when ingestion backlog spikes. Saw a 502 from the webhook relay around 03:12 UTC.
Priya: assigning myself to #4821, I'll validate the retry headers and update customer. PR for macro tweak ready: https://git.internal/r/support-macros/pulls/12 — short text change to add `temporary backlog workaround`.
Liam: I reviewed the PR, small wording nit. @Priya can you add the `--retry-after` suggestion? otherwise good to ship.
Priya: added the `--retry-after` line, pushed.
Ana: quick heads-up, we have a billing-related ticket bumped to P2 (ticket #4842) — needs triage; I'm taking that one.
Maya (support-lead): thanks. Nate — if you see more than 3 distinct customers hit the webhook error within 30m, escalate to eng-runtime and paste logs. If it's just noisy retries, we'll keep in support hands.
Nate (oncall): got it. Setting a short pager rule: if more than 3 unique customers in 30m, I’ll ping eng-runtime.
SupportBot: [alert] 1769999998: webhook-relay 502 spike (03:12 UTC) — 7 failures in 5m — linked to tickets #4821,#4830,#4835
Liam: small blocker — I still need approval from infra for a temporary capacity bump to reduce backlog. @Maya can you confirm?
Maya (support-lead): approved for a +1 instance for 45m if needed. Ping me with the deploy link before you spin up.
Priya: macro PR merged and deployed to KB. Macro title: "Webhook retry/backlog guidance (temporary)" — note for agents: include `--retry-after` header suggestion and the monitoring tip.
Ana: leaving a quick micro-update: taking #4842 and will confirm SLA timeline with customer.
Liam: spinning up the capacity bump now, will monitor. posting CPU/KV cache metrics in 10m.
Nate (oncall): I pulled logs for #4830 — attaching snippet (redacted):
```
[2026-03-17T03:12:14Z] relay.go:243 ERROR: post webhook failed status=502 payload_size=1892 retry=1
[2026-03-17T03:12:15Z] retry.go:88 INFO: queued retry after=2s customer_id=acct_91
```
Priya: nice, that aligns with the retry storm theory. I'll update the ticket with the log excerpt and the macro steps we deployed.
Maya (support-lead): anything else? quick asks: code review pings — @Liam can you please nudge eng-runtime on the webhook backpressure PR? it's been open 2 days.
Liam: pinged @eng-runtime in DMs and dropped a short note in the morning sync channel.
Nate (oncall): monitoring — no new customers affected in the last 8m. If that holds, we'll close the immediate escalation window.
Ana: confirmed #4842 customer acknowledged timeline, lowering to P3 for follow-up.
Maya (support-lead): great. Summary: Priya merged macro, Nate on watch for 2h, Liam did capacity bump, Ana owns billing ticket. I'll update the rotation board and add a brief note to the KB about temporary guidance. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Priya: leaving final note on #4821: customer updated, workaround applied, will follow up tomorrow with permanent fix ETA.
Nate (oncall): closing thread for now, will re-open if we see more errors.
